newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unit wins $15-million China pact.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit wins $15-million China pact.

text.p: Motorola Inc said its Asia Pacific Cellular Infrastructure Group signed a $15-million contract to expand the Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) network in Beijing.

Motorola said the unit will install more than 100 base stations in the fourth phase of the expansion project for Beijing Telecommunications Administration. The expansion will increase subscriber capacity to 500,000 from 250,000, the company said.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems and products.
Its shares were up two Thursday afternoon at 66-1/4.
